# Here’s the latest update on the Intraday Momentum Model featured in our paper “Beat the Market” with Andrew Aziz and Andrea Barbon · 2025-05-07T00:00:00+00:00

Here’s the latest update on the Intraday Momentum Model featured in our paper “Beat the Market” with Andrew Aziz and Andrea Barbon

In April, the strategy continued to benefit from heightened intraday volatility in U.S. markets, capturing both upward and downward moves. This led to a strong +4.3% monthly return, bringing year-to-date performance to +10.7%, compared to -5% for the S&P 500.

April also marked a high point in terms of trade efficiency:
1️⃣ Average PnL per share reached $1.60,
2️⃣ 1-year rolling average PnL per share now stands around $0.25, well above any conservative cost assumptions.

April also marked the best month in terms of average PnL per share, which reached $1.60, while the 1-year rolling average PnL per share now stands around $0.25, comfortably exceeding even a conservative transaction cost assumption.

Some readers recently raised concerns about the practical implementability of this approach. To address this, we analyzed slippage (vs. backtested execution prices) and commission data from a live sub-account trading a similar intraday momentum strategy on SPY over the past 6 months.

Key stats:
▶️ Average slippage per share: -$0.005
▶️ Average commission per share: $0.012
▶️ Average commission on BUY: $0.004
▶️ Average commission on SELL: $0.019
▶️ Total dollar volume traded: ~$100 million
